name: expiry_day_premium_decay_v1
author: claude_strategist
thesis: On weekly F&O expiry days (Thursdays), Nifty50 and BankNifty constituents experience increased volatility in the first hour due to options hedging/unhedging, followed by a mean reversion toward VWAP as gamma risk decays. Stocks that overshoot in the first hour due to options-driven flow revert because the temporary hedging pressure dissipates. Edge persists because expiry dynamics are driven by options market structure that only a fraction of equity traders understand.
stock_filter: top 15 Nifty50 stocks by open interest in current month options

risk.position_sizing: vol_adjusted — reduce size on expiry days (higher vol)

filters.vix_filter: vix_change < 0 (only when volatility is declining post-open)

edge.edge_decay_risk: low — expiry mechanics are structural to F&O market design

weaknesses: Only fires on Thursdays (52 trading days/year) — very low frequency
Monthly expiry is different from weekly — need separate parameters
If expiry falls on a macro-event day, options flow is overwhelmed by directional flow
prior_art: Expiry day effects — widely studied in Indian markets (NSE F&O expiry pinning, hedging flow)
notes: Track weekly vs monthly expiry separately. Monthly expiry (last Thursday) has stronger effects.
